clauses.clause: Scripted infected keep normal perception: within aggro range they engage the player, companions and survivors, in every level. PO: "even when they walk somewhere, they should still act like Zombies".
clauses.note: In L3/L4/L6/L8, both qualities, a visible escort2m from a runner interrupts ordinary complete-rush and receives real attack windups. With the authored finite courier focus, the same escort is never selected over120ticks; runner remains attracted and walks7.5–10m away toward courier30m away. This violates the unchanged normal-perception requirement for a nearby survivor, even though the preference is deliberate code.

evidence.what: Eight paired low/high finite-focus counterexamples with ordinary-rush attack controls; all300cells and four unresolved Alpha companion cases retained.

notes: No criteria, AI, target count, focus duration or caps changed. Companion detection redirects to courier without targeting corgi. Full-role coverage is not claimed.
